response:
The workspace tools are currently blocked by a system error in the Task Shield checker (all file and command operations return the same infrastructure failure), so I could not save the document to a file. To avoid leaving you without the deliverable, here is the complete offer letter, ready to copy into your own file.

The document follows the offer letter template from the loaded `employment-contract-templates` skill, customized for a senior software engineer. Replace any `[bracketed]` fields with your company's actual details.

---

```markdown
# EMPLOYMENT OFFER LETTER

[Company Letterhead]

Date: [DATE]

[Candidate Name]
[Address]
[City, State ZIP]

Dear [Candidate Name],

We are pleased to extend an offer of employment for the position of **Senior Software Engineer** at [COMPANY NAME]. We believe your skills and experience will be valuable additions to our engineering team.

## Position Details

**Title:** Senior Software Engineer
**Department:** Engineering
**Reports To:** [VP of Engineering / Engineering Manager Name]
**Location:** [Office Location / Remote]
**Start Date:** [Proposed Start Date]
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt
**Work Schedule:** Standard business hours, Monday through Friday; flexible scheduling available

## Responsibilities

In this role, you will:
- Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software solutions across [core product/platform]
- Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions
- Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level engineers
- Partner with product managers to translate requirements into technical specifications
- Champion code quality through code reviews, testing, and documentation
- Participate in on-call rotation for production support as needed

## Compensation

**Base Salary:** $[AMOUNT] per year, paid [bi-weekly/semi-monthly], subject to applicable withholdings

**Performance Bonus:** Eligible for an annual discretionary bonus of up to [X]% of base salary, based on company and individual performance

**Equity:** [X] stock options, vesting over 4 years with a 1-year cliff, subject to the terms of the Company's Equity Incentive Plan and a separate Stock Option Agreement

**Sign-On Bonus:** [X, if applicable — one-time payment of $X paid with your first payroll, subject to repayment terms if you voluntarily leave within 12 months]

## Benefits

You will be eligible for our standard benefits package, effective [date], including:
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401(k) with [X]% company match
- [X] days paid time off per year
- [X] paid company holidays
- Paid parental leave
- Professional development budget
- [Remote work stipend / Other benefits]

Full details will be provided during onboarding.

## Contingencies

This offer is contingent upon:
- Successful completion of a background check
- Verification of your legal right to work in [Country]
- Execution of required employment documents, including:
  - Employee Confidentiality and Proprietary Information Agreement
  - Invention and Intellectual Property Assignment Agreement
  - [Non-Compete Agreement, if applicable]

## At-Will Employment

Please note that employment with [Company Name] is at-will. This means that either you or the Company may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without cause or notice. This offer letter does not constitute a contract of employment for any specific period.

## Acceptance

To accept this offer, please sign below and return by [DEADLINE DATE, typically 5 business days from date of offer]. This offer will expire if not accepted by that date.

We are excited about the possibility of you joining our team. If you have any questions, please contact [HR Contact] at [email/phone].

Sincerely,

_________________________
[Hiring Manager Name]
[Title]
[Company Name]

---

## ACCEPTANCE

I accept this offer of employment and agree to the terms stated above.

Signature: _________________________

Printed Name: _________________________

Date: _________________________

Anticipated Start Date: _________________________
```

---

**Notes on tailoring this letter:**
- **Exempt classification** is assumed (typical for senior software engineers); confirm it meets the duties and salary threshold tests for your jurisdiction.
- **Equity language** should reference your actual equity plan, and a separate Stock Option Agreement will be signed.
- **Bonus and sign-on** language should be adjusted to reflect what you actually offer — avoid promising a bonus in writing if it is truly discretionary.
- **At-will language** is included; if you're in a jurisdiction without at-will employment, remove or revise that section.
- Per the skill's guidance, have employment counsel review before issuing, since employment law varies by location.

If you'd like, I can adjust any section (e.g., fill in real compensation figures, add a start-date-specific deadline, or adapt for a specific state/country). Note that file saving in this workspace is currently unavailable due to the tool error — you can save the block above to a `.md` or `.docx` file on your end.
